purpose: Track recurring reported features, measurement/evidence bottlenecks, contextual correlations, and discriminating tests across the frozen residual corpus without treating repetition as proof of common origin.

layers.PHENOMENON_REPORTED: What witnesses or sensors reportedly showed before physical validation.
layers.MEASUREMENT_VALIDATED: Patterns that survive geometry, calibration, synchronization, and uncertainty controls.
layers.EVIDENCE_PIPELINE: Patterns in reporting, archiving, custody, classification, sensor availability, and selection effects.
layers.CONTEXT: Operational or environmental settings that can create either real correlations or observation/reporting bias.

modern_control_context.source: AARO official imagery and reporting trends
modern_control_context.use: Calibrate how frequently apparently unusual imagery becomes ordinary after range, wind, flight-traffic, optical, parallax, or tracking controls. Do not merge modern control cases into historical case counts unless explicitly added by a future frozen registry revision.

promotion_rule: No pattern may count as evidence for H5 unless it survives case-level G3 calibrated measurement and relevant G4/G5 controls in at least two independently sourced cases. Narrative repetition alone cannot promote H5.
canonical_seal: COUNT PATTERNS, BUT COUNT THEIR FAILURE MODES TOO. COMMON WORDS ARE NOT COMMON PHYSICS.
